applies_why: The judge resolves a collision between CR2's chain and DR3's pressed sign-bounds, so K-C governs chain-against-chain weighing.
quote: the sign itself does not state the mechanism.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: The phrase never verse by verse supports weighing the competing chains by footing, while the judge instead treats Isaiah 7:14 alone as insufficient because it does not state the mechanism.
why: By declaring the sign underdetermined because the sign itself does not state the mechanism, the judge uses a verse-level deficiency test instead of weighing the competing chains by footing as K-C requires.
